name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: REINIT-TOKEN-EXPERIMENT BUILD, not for production: runs cleanup on two triggers -- app shutdown and new compose window open (back to the v0.5.0-style proactive trigger, replacing 0.4.x's reactive-on-send-failure design) -- and, when cleanup actually removes a stale cert9.db row, additionally logs the internal PKCS#11 token out and back in (nsIPKCS11Token.logout()/.login()) to test whether that forces NSS to drop whatever in-memory state goes stale, instead of relying on an incidental subsequent send to mask it.
